title: Replenishment flow missing — 12 consumable SKUs, 42-day cycle
narrative: Journeys deploy through the ESP and SMS APIs with their holdouts assigned before the first send — a flow cannot go live without one. Audiences and suppression sync last.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 4 deployed · 14 line items staged

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

targets.name: Klaviyo · email journeys
targets.meta: 3 created · 3 modified · 2 archived · holdouts armed at creation

items.name: Consumable replenishment · per-SKU interval
items.detail: Twelve entry conditions, one per SKU, each firing at that SKU’s median cycle. Free-shipping code, no percentage off, quiet hours honoured.

items.name: Post-first-delivery care · day 3–5
items.detail: Triggers off the carrier delivery event rather than the ship event, so the content lands after the box does.

items.name: Win-back at 90–120 days
items.detail: 10% offer, capped at the segment ceiling. Enrolment excludes anyone already in the replenishment flow.

items.name: Post-purchase thank-you · modified
items.detail: Trigger moves to order-confirmed and a holdout is attached, which makes its revenue claimable for the first time.

items.name: Browse abandon · trimmed to one email
items.detail: Emails two and three removed, bottom pLTV decile dropped from the audience. Existing 10% holdout carries over untouched.

items.name: Win-back 180-day · archived
items.detail: Archived rather than deleted so the ten weeks of holdout data stay attached to the version history.

targets.name: Attentive · SMS
targets.meta: 1 journey · express opt-ins only · 1,850 monthly reach

items.name: Refill reminder · day 40–45
items.detail: Audience restricted to the 6,240 profiles with a recorded express opt-in and its timestamp. One message, no offer, inside sending hours.

items.name: Quiet-hours and cap enforcement
items.detail: Sends are held to the recipient’s local 8am–9pm window and counted against the shared two-per-week SMS cap.

items.name: Replenishment audiences · 12 SKU cohorts
items.detail: One audience per consumable SKU, refreshed nightly from order history. Anyone who repurchases exits the flow the same night.

items.name: Bottom-decile monthly cohort
items.detail: Moved from the weekly promo pool to a monthly cadence. Consent and channel state untouched — this is a cadence change, not a suppression.

items.name: Suppression list refresh
items.detail: Unsubscribes, hard bounces and complaint records re-synced across both platforms before the first send of any new journey.

targets.name: Hypothesis Register
targets.meta: 3 tests registered · run inside the treated groups

items.name: Replenishment subject line · product vs cycle
items.detail: Two-arm split within the treated group. Sits on top of the holdout rather than replacing it, so both readings stay valid.

items.name: Replenishment offer · free shipping vs 10% off
items.detail: Settles the margin question with evidence. Discount arm is capped at the segment ceiling from Reason.

items.name: Win-back timing · day 90 vs day 120
items.detail: Finds the real edge of the window before anyone tunes the offer depth.

flags.rule: Lift decays more than 30% over four weeks
flags.action: Raises a flag here for a decision.

flags.rule: Complaint rate above 0.10% or unsub above 0.30%
flags.action: Holds the newest journey and notifies Keeper.

flags.rule: Measured lift below the projection’s P10
flags.action: Sends the flow back to Decide with the read attached.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, decay raises a flag on this card and waits for you.
